title: Fix Admin Access & Add Media Upload to Community Posts

requirements.summary: Add media attachment support (image, video, file) to Community post submission form with preview and display capabilities
acceptanceCriteria: Community post form has a media attachment button with options for image, video, or file upload.
After selecting an image, a preview thumbnail is shown before submission.
Text/caption field is present and required alongside any media.
Submitted posts containing images display the image inline in the community feed.
Submitted posts containing videos display a playable video player in the feed.
Submitted posts containing files display a downloadable file link in the feed.
File type and size validation provides user-friendly error messages for unsupported types.

file_operations.description: Update the community post submission form to include media attachment controls. Add a file input button with type selector (image/video/file) and display preview for selected images. Add validation for file types (JPG/PNG/GIF for images, MP4/WebM for videos) and file sizes. Convert selected files to ExternalBlob using ExternalBlob.fromBytes() before submission. Update the createCommunityPost mutation call to include the new optional parameters: image, video, and fileAttachment (with filename). Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing. Update the post feed rendering to display image blobs inline using ExternalBlob.getDirectURL(), render video players for video blobs, and show downloadable file links with filenames for file attachments. Ensure the text/caption field remains required.

Update the useCreateCommunityPost mutation hook to accept optional image, video, and fileAttachment parameters matching the backend interface signature. Pass these parameters to actor.createCommunityPost() alongside content and deityTag. Ensure proper type safety using the ExternalBlob and FileAttachment types from backend.d.ts.

Create a new CommunityPostCard component to encapsulate the display logic for a single community post. Refactor the post feed rendering to use the new CommunityPostCard component for each post in the list. Replace inline post rendering logic with <CommunityPostCard key={post.id} post={post} /> to improve code organization and reusability.
